en.headline: Coach accused of slapping boy, 8, given three-year good behaviour bond
en.dek: Zhao Yiqun, 51, faced child abuse charges over an August 2024 incident at a Cheung Chau training camp; the Department of Justice dropped the prosecution after an agreement.
body: A coach accused of slapping an eight-year-old boy and ordering him to stand under the hot sun during a training camp has been spared criminal charges after agreeing to a three-year good behaviour bond.

Chief Magistrate Victor So Wai-tak at Eastern Court on Wednesday imposed the bond on Zhao Yiqun, 51. She had faced two charges — ill-treatment or neglect by a person in charge of a child, and assault by a person caring for a minor — arising from an alleged incident on 8 August 2024 at the Jockey Club Ming Fai Camp on Cheung Chau.
Zhao’s lawyer told the court that the parties had reached an agreement and the Department of Justice would not continue the prosecution. Zhao had been due to enter a plea on the charges.

zh.headline: 教練涉掌摑8歲男童獲簽保守行為三年
zh.dek: 趙藝群被控在長洲訓練營虐待兒童及襲擊，律政司在雙方達成協議後不繼續檢控，東區裁判法院周三判簽保守行為。
body: 一名教練被控在長洲訓練營掌摑一名8歲男童，並指令他在烈日下站立，周三在東區裁判法院獲准簽保守行為三年，律政司不繼續檢控。
主任裁判官蘇惠德對51歲的趙藝群施加保守行為。她原本面對兩項控罪，包括對所看管兒童作出虐待或忽略，以及作為照顧未成年人的人作出襲擊，涉事日期為2024年8月8日，地點為長洲賽馬會明輝營。
趙藝群的代表律師向法庭表示，雙方已達成協議，律政司將不繼續檢控。趙原本須就控罪答辯。
